about_the_game:
This expansion pack includes over 30 additional maps that can be played in online games, bot mode, and co-op mode, as well as a sandbox editor.

With the sandbox editor, you can create your own game maps, share them with other players via the Workshop, or experience maps created by other players.

The Additional Map in Multiplayer:

Once you purchase the map pack, you can immediately use it for online game. Players who haven't purchased this DLC can still join your room and play with you. In other words, even if you're the only one who owns the DLC, you can share these maps for multiplayer games with your friends or other players.

Note about the editor:

The sandbox editor is a tool provided by the development team for players. However, due to the limited resources, our primary focus remains on the development of the main game. As a result, the editor may have stability issues with future updates. Additionally, using the editor requires a certain level of understanding and knowledge of the game's mechanics. If the sandbox mode is your main reason for purchasing this DLC, we advise you to carefully consider your decision.
